Villain Tradecraft.text: Villain tradecraft is how criminals with Quirks get by under a hero system that makes the basics hard to come by: cash, a place to sleep, work, and a way to hide a Quirk the state registered in their childhood. Brokers supply most of it for a fee: introductions to clients, safe rooms by the week, forged IDs, unregistered support gear and weapons, and hired muscle. Fences in pawnshops and back rooms buy stolen goods at a fraction of their worth. Jobs come by burner phone through a middleman, so hired hands rarely know who is paying or what the larger plan is; they are the first to be arrested and the last to be told anything. A villain with a distinctive Quirk or a mutant body covers up in public, because a registered Quirk caught on camera can lead the police to a name. Masks, aliases and cash are the ordinary tools of the trade, and loyalty lasts about as long as the money.
